rows.title: 第5期中期目標期間における基本ポートフォリオについて～詳細～ (5th Medium-term Plan policy asset mix, applied from 2025-04-01) — 「経済前提と各資産の期待リターン」
rows.horizon_years: long-term (pension-finance horizon; simulations shown at 25 and 50 years)
rows.asset_class: 国内債券 (domestic bonds, NOMURA-BPI ex ABS) — scenario: 高成長実現ケース (high-growth case)
rows.quote: Table 「経済前提と各資産の期待リターン」, row 「高成長実現ケース」: 物価上昇率 2.0% / 実質賃金上昇率 2.0% / 名目賃金 4.0% / 期待短期金利 2.9% / 名目期待リターン: 国内債券 3.2% 外国債券 4.9% 国内株式 7.5% 外国株式 8.1%. 本文: 「期待リターンは、国内債券で-0.3％～3.2％、外国債券で1.4％～4.9％、国内株式で4.0％～7.5％、外国株式で4.6％～8.1％となりました。」
rows.note: Expected returns = expected short rate + risk premium (building-block) blended with equilibrium returns, under the 4 long-run economic scenarios of the 2024 pension financial verification. Foreign assets in yen terms, unhedged. GPIF target: nominal wage growth + 1.9%. Published March 2025 (PDF created 2025-03-27); still the current policy portfolio as of 2026-10.

rows.title: 2026 capital market assumptions — full report (20-year horizon; estimates as of December 31, 2025)
rows.asset_class: JPY appreciation vs USD (FX assumption, per year)
rows.quote: "A meaningful contributor to this high expected return is our view that the Japanese yen will appreciate against the U.S. dollar over time, enhancing USD-based investors' gains. In fact, our latest assumptions foresee a slightly larger annual yen rise (around 2.2% per year against the dollar, up marginally from last year), reflecting yen undervaluation and adding a tailwind to Japan's local equity returns when measured in USD terms."
rows.note: Stated as "around 2.2% per year"; the 6.8% Japan equity return is in USD terms and includes this currency tailwind.

No 2025-2026 long-term CMA document with numbers found publicly (searches returned only the short-term 2026 cross-asset outlook and the institutional survey). Possibly restricted to professional clients.

UBS AM's public CMA page still shows the 2020 edition (no numbers for 2025-2026); UBS's approach page says baseline 5/10-year and equilibrium assumptions are updated quarterly but are not published. The UBS Global Investment Returns Yearbook 2026 is historical (1900-2025), not a forecast, so it was not recorded.
GIC Annual Capital Market Assumptions (7-year and 20-year) PDFs found via search could not be retrieved (server errors/503); no verifiable 2026 figures obtained.
No 2026 'Long View' / long-term CMA edition found (2026 Long View URLs return 404; latest public results are 2025 editions).
2026 capital market expectations described qualitatively in press coverage; no 2026 numeric 10-year figures found in a primary source.
